mathematics.assertion_tested: The three authorized 1.1 finite check suites pass their declared exact and floating assertions, reproduce the exact certificates and parameter inverse examples, and regenerate all 14 scientific figure pairs from an isolated immutable input snapshot.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact integers and fractions.Fraction rationals for 5272 assertions; 26 separately counted binary floating comparisons. Figures use exact rational certificate data, binary floating plotting and roots, and 100-decimal-digit mpmath for weak-tap illustrations.
mathematics.conventions: U and V are normalized odd solutions of U'=1+U(qz)V(rz), V'=1+U(az)V(bz), with U(0)=V(0)=0. Odd derivative index n has power 2n+1; ordinary Taylor coefficients divide by (2n+1)!. Positive entire certificates require 0<q,r,a,b<1. Polyphase lanes index full derivative arrays modulo the base, and ordinary FIR shifts are zero-constant EGF integration shifts. Signed prime-2 atoms have weight (1 or -delta)/n^4 at x_n=(1-1/n^2)^2 for squarefree n, including n=1.

All 256 points in {1/5,2/5,3/5,4/5}^4 for inverse and reduction identities, plus three declared scalar reductions.
Weak-tap weights 10^-1,10^-3,10^-6 in exact coefficient comparisons; five numerical weights 10^-k for k=1,3,6,9,12.

Project-local proof notes and three original 1.0 proofs are provenance inputs, not additional executed proof checks.
non_claims: The 1.0 baseline is unchanged and is not rerun or included in this release-run assertion count.
A successful run verifies the implemented finite assertion in the stated range, not universal growth, reduction, exact inverse, or signed-measure positivity theorems.
The separately audited proofs supply all universal statements. Pinning a proof file does not turn it into an executable proof.
Floating roots, plots, comparisons and 100-digit values are not directed-rounding interval enclosures.
No ordinary type-limit existence, instantaneous component growth ratio convergence, or historical priority is inferred.
The exact parameter inverse is not asserted uniformly stable near D=0.
Degrees five and six of the chosen signed detector remain unresolved; degree seven is not claimed minimal.
A sufficient weak-tap separation radius is not the first or minimal radius. Prime subtraction conditioning is not a universal precision requirement for every algorithm.
Execution failure is not a mathematical counterexample unless an independently validated violated mathematical assertion is identified; timeout/resource limits would be inconclusive.
Resource limits on address space and CPU time are per process, and numerical thread limits are cooperative. Figure byte identity across software/fonts/platforms is not claimed.
